## ✅ Checklist

Please ensure all items are completed before requesting review:

- [ ] My code follows the project's code style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas (explain "why" not "what")
- [ ] I have updated documentation (if needed)
- [ ] I have not added any hardcoded secrets or credentials
- [ ] I have not committed `.env` or `config.json` files
- [ ] My changes do not increase memory usage significantly (important for Pi Zero 2 W)
- [ ] I have tested on the relevant hardware/environment
- [ ] No breaking changes without clear justification

## 🔒 Security Review

- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or API keys
- [ ] Configuration uses environment variables or examples
- [ ] No new dependencies without clear justification
- [ ] Changes respect POC vs. Production security model
- [ ] Authentication and token handling is secure
